newsitem.title: USA: Waste Technology Corp merges subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Waste Technology Corp merges subsidiary.

text.p: Waste Technology Corp said on Monday that it will merge its 85-percent owned subsidiary, International Baler Corp, into a new wholly owned subsidiary in a move that it expects to increase Waste Tech's earnings per share.
The merger, which will take the form of a stock exchange, has already been approved by shareholders of both companies, Waste Tech said in a statement.
Under terms of the merger, IBC minority shareholders will receive shares of Waste Tech, a waste material equipment company.

The exchange will be based on the average of the closing bid and asked prices of Waste Tech on June 27, 1997, the company said. The issuance of stock in exchange for the IBC shares is expected to increase Waste TEch's shares outstanding to about 5,235,715.
